The game features smooth gameplay mechanics, responsive controls (using accelerometer), and an immersive racing experience optimized for mobile devices.

projects.title: StepUp
projects.description: StepUp is a manual fitness and workout logging app built with React Native that helps users track their daily workouts, set weekly goals, and monitor progress. With offline-first architecture using AsyncStorage, it provides a clean interface to log workouts, manage rest days, and visualize weekly fitness achievements.
projects.languages: React Native | Expo | AsyncStorage | Context API | React Navigation | JavaScript
